scope: Critic recommendations implemented in development code; release 0.2.1 downloads unchanged.
changes: Vantage: nine recommended play decks separated from eleven interaction test pilots. Four new supported play lists; frozen existing lists and IDs retained. Deck-health hints identify missing breaker types and unsupported Baker/stealth combinations.
Lobby actions remain in normal document flow and no longer overlay deck selectors.
Corp install picker groups equivalent physical copies and asks for a destination after the card; single-destination choices retain a direct quoted action. Differently priced copies remain separate.
Optional-effect decline and hidden-access zone labels are explicit without exposing card identity. Jailbreak's mandatory successful-run trigger is named and streamlined.
Unavailable breaker cards use compact explanations. Bioroid break-all uses a bounded series of current native choices and stops when costs, subroutines, priority, or the encounter change.
Installation confirmation lives in one modal; the sidebar only reopens it. Postgame hides priority and stale receipts. Printed click symbols render accessibly in card text.

browser.method: Actual shared-browser DOM controls, no engine choice injection. Targeted checkpoints restored using Paste game replay.
